propositions: A new append-only NDJSON snapshot store at `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` persists point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage, complexity, clone count) across CI runs so their trend accrues.
The `write_snapshot(dict)` function appends a timestamped record to the NDJSON file and `read_snapshots(since,until)` yields records within a date range for consumption by the registry.
The snapshot file must live under `.rebar/` (a tracked directory) not `reports/` (gitignored) so the accumulated series is committed and synced rather than silently lost.
`.gitignore` must include `!.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` to surgically un-ignore the snapshot file, overriding the blanket `.rebar/*` ignore rule that would otherwise suppress it.
The reader gracefully skips malformed or truncated NDJSON lines without raising and returns only valid records.
